payload.core_mechanism_summary: Encode vitamin sets as 3-bit masks; precompute min cost for each mask; then try all combinations of up to 3 masks to find minimum cost with union = 7.
payload.rationale: Solution is complete search with bitmask encoding, not dynamic programming. dp_bitmask is chosen as the closest listed subtype due to bitmask usage, but family mismatch as it is not DP.
